mapper.insert: insert into admin(username, password, phone, email) values (#{username}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{email})
mapper.update: update admin set username = #{username}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, updatetime = #{updatetime}, status = #{status} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: /*select要加resultType*/ select * from admin order by id desc

select * from admin
/* 条件不为空时查询，为空则跳过 */ username like concat('%',#{ username },'%')
and phone like concat('%',#{ phone },'%')
and email like concat('%',#{email},'%')
order by id desc
